en.section: MACM401 没有 Gröbner 基与消元

§2.1 term orders and initial ideals; §2.2 division algorithm; §2.3 applications to solving systems by elimination; §2.13 Buchberger's algorithm and S-polynomials; exercises for Day 1. Combine with Sturmfels Chapter 2 (Gröbner bases of zero-dimensional ideals) and Chapter 4 (resultants/elimination)

topics.note: 中文课程与第二章课件明确讲 Gröbner 基与消元；英文 MACM401 不讲，故补 Cox–Little–O'Shea 第 2–3 章（付费）。这是本节英文的付费补充，不是免费完整路线。；The existing English route had MACM401 for polynomial algorithms and symbolic integration, but MACM401 explicitly has no Gröbner bases or elimination; the only English coverage was the paid Cox–Little–O'Shea book (en2). Boocher's free lecture notes give term orders, initial ideals, the division algorithm, Buchberger's algorithm and the elimination-order application, with exercises; Sturmfels's author-hosted free book gives elimination ideals, resultants, zero-dimensional Gröbner bases and worked Singular/Macaulay2 examples. Together they cover the definition, construction and elimination use of Gröbner bases, so the paid book is no longer needed for this topic.

steps.read: 看第 1–4 次课多项式基础与计算机代数入门。
看多项式消元与方程求解部分，配合 zh2 第二章课件学结式、Gröbner 基、Buchberger 与消元。
看计算交换代数／代数几何与几何定理机器证明，理解应用。
用 Sage 教程的多项式／理想／groebner_basis() 例子做实际计算。
Watch the integer/polynomial arithmetic, gcd, resultant, modular/FFT, Hensel and factorization lectures.
Do the Maple worksheets for formula representation, differentiation and symbolic integration.
Read §2.1–2.3: monomial term orders, initial ideal, division algorithm, and the elimination-order recipe for solving polynomial systems; do the Day 1 exercises.
Read §2.13 Buchberger's algorithm and the S-pair definition; compute a small Gröbner basis by hand, then check it with a CAS.

Read Chapter 2 (standard monomials, radical, companion matrices, solving in Singular) and Chapter 4 (univariate and multivariate resultants, elimination theory); run the book's Singular/Macaulay2 examples on one small system.
